title: Calgary-area mapped childcare, preschools, gyms and sports centres
scoreIntegration: Supplemental distance categories only; no weight or change to nearby-essentials-v1.

categoryDefinitions.label: Mapped childcare
categoryDefinitions.licensing: Not verified against Alberta licensing records.

categoryDefinitions.label: Mapped preschool / kindergarten
categoryDefinitions.licensing: OSM tag meaning can differ by country. Not a verified childcare licence or full-day childcare offering.

categoryDefinitions.label: Mapped gym / fitness centre
categoryDefinitions.filter: leisure=fitness_centre OR leisure=sports_centre with sport list containing fitness

categoryDefinitions.label: Mapped sports centre
categoryDefinitions.filter: Other leisure=sports_centre. May be a pool, rink, climbing centre or other sport. Do not label all as gyms.

coverage: Citywide extraction extent plus a roughly 3km rectangular buffer; complete query response does not establish complete real-world mapping. No missing category is evidence that no facility exists.
distanceRule: Nearest mapped point by haversine straight-line distance. Label origin as selected property marker or area reference point. Do not present route distance or walking minutes.
nearestResultRule: For an optional search radius, return null and not-observed-within-range when no point is observed; do not return a fabricated distance or zero. For citywide nearest, disclose that nearest means nearest within this extracted map data.
limits: OSM node coordinates and bounding-box centres are not verified public entrances.
Childcare availability, age eligibility, opening hours and licensing are not established by this map. Verify through Alberta Childcare Search and the provider.
Fitness/sports categories do not establish membership costs, public entry or accessible facilities.
OSM node/area duplicates can remain; this extract retains unique OSM element IDs, without merging separate source objects based on names.
licenseHandling: Keep this OSM-derived data separate from City extracts, display © OpenStreetMap contributors with copyright link, and distribute under linked ODbL.
